newsitem.title: USA: Columbia/HCA wont invest in America's Health.
newsitem.headline: Columbia/HCA wont invest in America's Health.

text.p: Embattled health care services company Columbia/HCA Healthcare Corp said Wednesday it had decided against making a majority interest investment in America's Health Network.
Columbia also said that as of June 30 it had spent $730 million repurchasing 20 million common shares as part of a $1 billion repurchase program started in April.

The announcements came within days of the resignations of chief executive officer Richard Scott and president David Vandewater. Both men departed amid government investigations into possible Medicare and Medicaid fraud by the company. Vice Chairman Thomas Frist has assumed Columbia's top post.
Columbia/HCA announced Tuesday that second quarter earnings rose 13 percent, to $0.62 a share from $0.54 during the same period a year ago.
